response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tooling (test runners, CI/CD, fluent assertions), and clear leadership in open-source and workshop initiatives, but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience beyond informal mentorship and lacks mobile platform focus, which is a preferred qualification.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership through open-source projects and workshops
Broad technical stack across mobile, web, and systems languages with strong testing focus
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership responsibilities
Limited demonstrated experience with mobile platform ecosystems (iOS/Android) as required
No mention of strategic roadmap planning or organizational change leadership
